summary: Phase 1 frontend testing for MonthlyPulse/SereneBudget completed successfully. All requested features verified: app boots on Overview tab, add-expense flow works, donut chart renders with center 'spent' total after 4 expenses added (data-testid='donut-chart' visible), insights-card renders with insight-week line (weekend insight conditional and absent for this seed, which is expected), History search-by-note works (Coffee -> 1 result), category filter chips work (Food -> 2 results), advanced-filters toggle opens/closes advanced-filters panel, min-amount (>=30 -> 2 results) and max-amount (30-50 -> 1 result) filters work, all range chips (all/month/3m/year) clickable, clear-filters resets state to trend view, all three DATA & BACKUP buttons present and functional (CSV download triggered file 'monthlypulse-2026-08-15.csv', JSON backup triggered 'monthlypulse-backup-2026-08-15.json' with 'Backup file created' toast), budget save/currency/rollover/category-add all still work. Month-end recap card correctly hidden (daysLeft>5). No crashes, no red screen, no page errors. Two minor console warnings: React Native web deprecation notice for shadow* style props (cosmetic, non-blocking).

issues: On a 390x844 mobile viewport, some scrollable content inside modals (category selector, save-expense-button, add-category modal fields) sits partially or fully outside the initial viewport and Playwright's default click was blocked with 'Element is outside of the viewport'. Real users can scroll, but ensure the modal ScrollView content fully accommodates smaller screens (iPhone SE ~667px height). Not a blocker – dispatch_event click succeeded, indicating the element is present and functional.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted from styles across multiple components (heroCard, fab, toast, etc.). Non-blocking but should be migrated to the boxShadow shorthand for forward compatibility with react-native-web.

action_items: Consider migrating shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius style properties to the new boxShadow shorthand to silence React Native Web deprecation warnings (index.tsx and other style sheets).
Optionally, verify that the ExpenseModal and BudgetPanel add-category modal render fully within a 390x667 viewport without requiring scroll for primary CTA (save button) – for improved iPhone SE UX.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 713 lines – consider splitting Overview screen content into its own component to stay under 700 lines per file guideline.
In DataManager.tsx, `expo-file-system/legacy` import is used – ensure this legacy path is intentional (newer SDKs prefer `expo-file-system` primary API).
seed_data_creation: Test playwright script created 4 in-app expenses (Food x2, Transport, Fun) via UI to exercise donut/insights/history filters. State is persisted in localStorage key 'serene-budget' (browser-local, not shared).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1 features (search by amount+date, donut chart, weekend/weekday insight, CSV/JSON export, JSON import, month-end recap) implemented correctly. Weekend insight is conditional (requires >=4 monthEx AND a ~25% weekend/weekday spending imbalance) – do not fail if absent. Month-recap-card only appears in last 5 days of month. When testing modals on 390x844 viewport, use locator.dispatch_event('click') instead of page.click() for content below the fold, or set viewport height to 1200.
